segments.sn35.61:1.4: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. Tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso.
segments.sn35.61:1.6: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, rūpesupi nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati, cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.61:1.7: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimokkhā ‘pariyādinnaṃ [sabbatthapi evameva dissati dantaja-nakāreneva] me upādānan’ti pajānāti … pe … jivhañca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ … pe … manañca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ.
segments.sn35.61:1.11: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako manasmimpi nibbindati, dhammesupi nibbindati, manoviññāṇepi nibbindati manosamphassepi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.61:1.12: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimokkhā ‘pariyādinnaṃ me upādānan’ti pajānāti.
